congratulations to all ‘birdies for buddy’ a sincere word of congratulations and appreciation to everyone involved in the recent ‘birdies for buddy’ fundrais er, held at waterville golf links on saturday last. the day was truly blessed with beautiful sunshine, making it a wonderful occa sion filled with goodwill, generosity and community spirit. it was hea rtening to see so many people come together in support of this very worthy cause, raising funds for buddy and his pals at st francis special school in beaufort. a special word of thanks and appreciation to michael, miriam and all the team at waterville golf links for their generosity in making this wonderful event possible. their cont inued support for our community, and their kindness towards those in n eed, is greatly appreciated and is a wonderful example of the diffe rence we can make when we come together for others. to everyone who organised, participated in, sponsor ed and supported the fundraiser in any way, thank you. your generosity will make a real difference to buddy and his friends, and your support is a testament to the kindness and compassion that exists within our community. mass of remembrance for our deceased 25/26 friday 13th november: st finian’s 7.30pm one of the most cherished moments in our parish calendar is annual mass of remembrance for those who have died during the past year. we will gather in prayer for all our parishioners and loved ones who haved ied during 2025 and 2026, remembering their lives, giving thanks for the gifts they shared with us, and entrusting them to the loving mercy of god. this mass will be an opportunity for families and friends to come together in faith, to find comfort in the eucharist, and to remember those whose absence is still deeply felt. please contact the parish office to include names of those who died outside of the parish that you would like included in our mass. in november we remember as we welcome the month of november, the church invites us to turn our hearts in a special way towards the holy souls and to remember with love and gratitude all those who have gone before us marked with the sign of faith. november is a month of quiet reflection, heartfelt prayer and christian hope. we remember our parents, grandparents, relatives, friends, parishioners and all those whose lives have touched our own. though they are no longer with us in this earthly life, the bonds of love remain , and we continue to entrust them to the mercy and goodness of god. the church reminds us that death does not have the final word. through the death and resurrection of jesus christ, we are given the promise of etern al life. as we pray for the faithful departed, we are united with them in the communion o f saints, trusting that god's love is greater than death itself. “eternal rest grant unto them, o lord, and let perpetu al light shine upon them. may they rest in peace. amen.” the holy souls preparing for 30 days helping our dearly departed retreat at the oratory of divine mercy november lists of the dead during november, holy masses and prayers will be offered for all those remembered on our november lists of the month. we are deeply grateful for your prayerful remembrance and offering. date for the diary blessing of the oratory of the divine mercy friday 6 november 11:00am th by bishop ray browne - bishop of
